name: After § 44
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 44a. Stresses that the next MFF should support the development of additive manufacturing as a strategic enabling technology for European industry that is essential to strengthening the Union’s competitiveness, reducing critical dependencies in supply chains, shortening production chains and promoting manufacturing processes that make more efficient use of energy and raw materials; calls for targeted funding for research, industrial experimentation, standardisation, support for certification processes, technology transfer and access for SMEs and start-ups to these technologies; insists that the next MFF should support not only technological development, but also the validation, certification and market entry of industrial outputs produced through additive manufacturing, in order to make the fullest possible use of the advantages offered by digital and flexible manufacturing, new products, qualified employment and commercial opportunities for European companies;
